name: Vâlcea
summary: Vâlcea can refer to: an old, silted valley with well-defined slopes fixed by the vegetal carpet; it lacks drainage and has an almost flat, slightly inclined bottom. Vâlcea County. Localities in Romania: Râmnicu Vâlcea, Vâlcea, Alba, Vâlcea, Brașov.
